description: Add an RSS/Atom feed to a topic inbox. You can pass the site address instead of the feed URL — the server fetches the page and discovers the feed. If it fails, the reason is precise (blocked by the site, gone, unreadable) so it can be reported honestly.

url.description: Feed URL or plain site address, e.g. "ilpost.it"

name: add_feed
title: Add an RSS feed
